changelog: The lead page's history shows planned meetings — "Meeting scheduled for <when>" in the viewer's time zone, and a second line when one is cancelled (#3837). Read from the existing `Meeting` rows; nothing is written to `InteractionLog`, since planning a meeting is not a contact (last-contact rule, counters, metering). The meeting title is shown only to viewers who may work the record.

en: A lead's history now shows when a meeting was scheduled or cancelled.
tr: Lead geçmişinde artık toplantının ne zaman planlandığı ya da iptal edildiği görünüyor.
de: Im Verlauf eines Leads steht jetzt, wann ein Termin vereinbart oder abgesagt wurde.
